View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1144

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re diving into Meta’s Q3 earnings to see why Muse, the first AI agent to reach 10M users, now needs permission from Amazon & the big banks that blocked it (the Muse numbers Meta disclosed and the one it withheld, why Meta will charge merchants rather than shoppers, how negative free cash flow is forcing it to monetize early, & the signal that decides whether Meta becomes the broker for agent commerce + bonus deep dives into Claude Commerce Agents, or Anthropic’s Merchant-Side Bet on Agentic Commerce [ https://substack.com/redirect/e0e040c5-ef61-4c61-bb11-a01ecfa6be14?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] and How to Run The One-Person Company on Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/3ac16181-ddc5-436b-a10f-28ffab97437c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and unpacking Revolut that’s finally using its banking licences to lend, and why it wants to keep its loan book close to 6% of deposits when it could go much bigger (why only £151M of its £974M interest income came from loans, how a $115B valuation explains the cap, what my own Revolut mortgage invite in Lithuania reveals about the order it plans to sell credit in, & what to watch for next + bonus dives into why Revolut is building its own Meta Muse & Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/eb6b0f22-3799-492f-8dd9-bbe10607dae1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and a really deep dive into Revolut [ https://substack.com/redirect/cfb72ba1-2ee4-4a6c-97fc-a9395324a204?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Meta’s Muse AI Agent hit 10 million users in six weeks. Amazon and the banks now decide what it earns 🤖🔒
Following the agents 🤖 Meta’s Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/a18fc425-55b6-41d5-92ef-8642907869d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is the first AI agent with mass-market traction. More than 10 million people in the U.S. and Canada set it up in about six weeks, mostly to shop. But Amazon $AMZN  has blocked Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/1aa7f231-e821-4b68-a167-582d1e1dec1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and JPMorgan  [ https://substack.com/redirect/40219ac4-ae08-4538-ac3a-237f8cb9aed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]$JPM  and other large U.S. banks have shut agents like it out of customer accounts [ https://substack.com/redirect/40219ac4-ae08-4538-ac3a-237f8cb9aed8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 81510.subject: 🧬 What Claude deleted from a cancer treatment
81510.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude redesigned part of a cancer treatment and it works better than the one humans made. Google's Genie 4 builds a world you can walk into and talk to, possibly changing video game design forever. Four ex-DOGE staffers failed to break into Anthropic's systems, so they walked in through its HR software instead. ChatGPT also got into your iCloud inbox today.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Claude:** Which cancer treatment did Claude just redesign?

* **Google:** Who talks back inside Google's new world?

* **Anthropic:** Which door did the ex-DOGE hackers walk through?

* **ChatGPT:** Can ChatGPT access all inboxes now?


----------







----------
## Claude redesigned a cancer treatment and its version won

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/83c5e825-95ef-4f8d-a025-c73a14a0fea2/51ef9254-08c1-4da2-b7fe-d69b0c4ca30b.jpg?t=1793177904)
Caption: 

Six scientists at Generate Biomedicines [had Claude Code redesign part of a cancer therapy](https://www.anthropic.com/research/early-progress-drug-development). One design came out about 70% shorter than the standard, and in lab tests it made roughly 10 times as many of the proteins immune cells use to find cancer.

The therapy is CAR T, which reprograms a patient's own immune cells to hunt tumors. It works on blood cancers, and Generate wants it to work on solid tumors, which means squeezing in more instructions.

Nobody has tested the short version in an animal or a person yet.

Anthropic published six of these drug partnerships now.

* Claude drew up about 35,000 antibody designs for a food allergy drug in a month, mostly on its own.

* At Enveda it cut a manufacturing review from 25.9 hours to 2.8 and caught 7 problems human reviewers had missed.

* It wrote the first draft of a regulatory filing in 4 hours. By hand that takes about 3 months.

Anthropic also bought Mithril Medicine, a drug company with exactly one employee. He used Claude to run experiments across 11 outside labs and took a muscular dystrophy treatment from idea to promising results in mice in under 18 months.

Human trials could start as soon as late 2028.


----------
